description.value: Established in 1997, Tandoori Grill is one of Whistler's longest-running Indian restaurants, occupying a second-floor space at the corner of Main Street and Northlands Boulevard. The kitchen specialises in clay-oven tandoor cooking at 600 °F — a technique rooted in Mughal culinary tradition — using free-range chicken, premium lamb, and Oceanwise seafood. Touring cyclists will find a broad menu that accommodates vegans, vegetarians, and gluten-free diets, with pickup and local delivery also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and confirms the business is an active, established Indian restaurant in Whistler since 1997. Takeout/pickup and vegetarian/vegan/GF options are explicitly confirmed by the website.
